insights: Pakistan's 2023 population is 241.50 M, up from 207.68 M in 2017 - an average growth of 2.55% per year.
Punjab holds 52.9% of the national population; Balochistan grew fastest at 3.19% per year.
38.9% of people live in urban areas. Urban population grew 3.66%/yr vs 1.88%/yr for rural areas.
Ziarat (Balochistan) urbanised the most: +23.9 percentage points between 2017 and 2023.
Karachi Central is the most densely populated district at 55,396 people per km².
29 districts are 'high growth zones' (>3%/yr); 2 grew below 1%/yr.
There are 94.2 females per 100 males nationally; the largest male-female literacy gap is in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (27.6 points).
